---
title: "Cytek Fluor Suggestions"
format: html
---

```{r}
library(Luciernaga)
```


```{r}
QC_ReferenceLibrary("BB", 64)
```

```{r}
Plots <- QC_SimilarFluorophores("cFluor R685", 64, returnPlots=TRUE)
Plots[[1]]
plotly::ggplotly(Plots[[2]])
```
